prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1085; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection and was struck by your insured's vehicle. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is pursuing a claim for compensation.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly. If your insured is represented by counsel, please forward this letter to them.

We request that you provide the full policy limits of liability coverage applicable to your insured for this loss, along with a copy of the declarations page.

We also ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, witness statements, claim file materials, repair and total loss records, dispatch or telematics data, and any recorded statements. Please take all steps necessary to prevent the loss, alteration, or destruction of such materials.
